articles.title: Gaza turned into ‘toxic wasteland’ by Israel’s war, says new report
Israel’s destruction of Gaza has created a ‘toxic wasteland’, experts find
articles.summary: Scientific and satellite findings warn of widespread contamination in Gaza, posing grave threats to public health ‘for generations to come’ Israel’s destruction of Gaza has left a devastating environmental legacy with poisoned water, contaminated soil and toxic air threatening the life-support systems that the population depends on for survival, according to a report.
